paper_title: Monopole-vortex continuity of N = 1 super Yang-Mills theory on R^2 x S^1 x S^1 with 't Hooft twist (Hayashi, 2025, JHEP)
deeper_reasoning_2:
\textbf{Claim.} The large-\(L_3\) bion potential, the small-\(L_3\) twisted constant-mode constraint, the integrated-in superpotential, and the center-vortex operator algebra all use the same \(\mathbb Z_N\) label. Consequently,
\[
\vec z_k=\frac{2\pi i k}{N}\vec\rho,\qquad
\langle\operatorname{tr}(\lambda\lambda)\rangle_k=16\pi^2\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N},
\]
and the vortex-induced order parameter has Fourier eigenphase \(e^{2\pi i k/N}\).

\textbf{Premises.}
\begin{align*}
(P1)\quad & V(\vec z)=0\Longleftrightarrow
e^{\vec\alpha_1\cdot\vec z}=\cdots=e^{\vec\alpha_N\cdot\vec z}=:q
\text{ and }q^N=1.\\
(P2)\quad & q^N=1\Longleftrightarrow q=e^{2\pi i k/N},\quad k=0,\ldots,N-1.\\
(P3)\quad & \vec z_k:=\frac{2\pi i k}{N}\vec\rho
\text{ satisfies }e^{\vec\alpha_j\cdot\vec z_k}=e^{2\pi i k/N}
\quad (j=1,\ldots,N).\\
(P4)\quad & P_W\vec\rho=\vec\rho-N\vec\mu_1,\qquad
\vec z\sim\vec z+2\pi i\vec\mu\text{ for every integral weight }\vec\mu.\\
(P5)\quad & \text{Small-}L_3\text{ constant modes obey }\vec z=P_W^{-1}\vec z
\text{ modulo the weight-lattice periodicity}.\\
(P6)\quad & W(Z,\Sigma)=NL_4\Lambda^3e^{i\theta/N}e^Z+\Sigma(e^{NZ}-1).\\
(P7)\quad & \text{Supersymmetric vacua of (P6) obey }e^{NZ}=1
\text{ and }\Sigma=-L_4\Lambda^3e^{i\theta/N}e^Z.\\
(P8)\quad & W_k:=W(Z_k,\Sigma_k),\qquad
\langle\operatorname{tr}(\lambda\lambda)\rangle_k
:=\frac{16\pi^2}{NL_4}\Lambda^3
\frac{\partial W_k}{\partial(\Lambda^3)}.\\
(P9)\quad & \omega:=e^{2\pi i/N},\quad
P_2|m\rangle=\omega^m|m\rangle,\quad
\mathcal O|m\rangle=A|m+1\rangle,\quad
\mathcal O:=\operatorname{tr}(\lambda\lambda).\\
(P10)\quad & |f_k\rangle:=\frac{1}{\sqrt N}\sum_{m\in\mathbb Z_N}\omega^{-km}|m\rangle.\\
(P11)\quad & e^ae^b=e^{a+b},\qquad
\frac{\partial}{\partial(\Lambda^3)}(\Lambda^3 C)=C
\text{ when }C\text{ is independent of }\Lambda^3.
\end{align*}

\textbf{Derivation.}
The large-\(L_3\) vacuum equation first reduces the problem to a root of unity:
\begin{align*}
V(\vec z)=0
&\Longleftrightarrow q^N=1 && \text{by (P1)}\\
&\Longleftrightarrow q=e^{2\pi i k/N},\quad k=0,\ldots,N-1. && \text{by (P2)}
\end{align*}
The representatives \(\vec z_k\) realize these roots for every affine root by (P3). They also satisfy the small-\(L_3\) twisted constant-mode condition:
\begin{align*}
P_W\vec z_k
&=P_W\left(\frac{2\pi i k}{N}\vec\rho\right) && \text{by (P3)}\\
&=\frac{2\pi i k}{N}(\vec\rho-N\vec\mu_1) && \text{by (P4)}\\
&=\vec z_k-2\pi i k\vec\mu_1 && \text{algebra}\\
&\sim\vec z_k. && \text{by (P4)}
\end{align*}
Thus the large-\(L_3\) bion vacua and small-\(L_3\) twisted constant modes have the same \(k\)-label.

The superpotential gives the same label in the local holomorphic observable. From (P7),
\begin{align*}
e^{Z_k}=e^{2\pi i k/N},\qquad
\Sigma_k=-L_4\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}. && \text{by (P7), (P11)}
\end{align*}
On shell, the constraint term vanishes, so
\begin{align*}
W_k
&=NL_4\Lambda^3e^{i\theta/N}e^{Z_k} && \text{by (P6)}\\
&=NL_4\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}. && \text{by (P11)}
\end{align*}
Therefore
\begin{align*}
\langle\operatorname{tr}(\lambda\lambda)\rangle_k
&=\frac{16\pi^2}{NL_4}\Lambda^3
\frac{\partial}{\partial(\Lambda^3)}
\left(NL_4\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}\right) && \text{by (P8)}\\
&=\frac{16\pi^2}{NL_4}\Lambda^3
\left(NL_4e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}\right) && \text{by (P11)}\\
&=16\pi^2\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N}. && \text{cancel }NL_4
\end{align*}
This result has no remaining \(L_3\) or \(L_4\) dependence.

It remains to check that the center-vortex operator algebra has the same Fourier label. Acting on \(|f_k\rangle\),
\begin{align*}
\mathcal O|f_k\rangle
&=\frac{1}{\sqrt N}\sum_{m\in\mathbb Z_N}\omega^{-km}\mathcal O|m\rangle && \text{by (P10)}\\
&=\frac{A}{\sqrt N}\sum_{m\in\mathbb Z_N}\omega^{-km}|m+1\rangle && \text{by (P9)}\\
&=\frac{A}{\sqrt N}\sum_{n\in\mathbb Z_N}\omega^{-k(n-1)}|n\rangle && \text{set }n=m+1\\
&=A\omega^k|f_k\rangle. && \text{by (P10)}
\end{align*}
Moreover, on every \(|m\rangle\),
\begin{align*}
\mathcal O P_2|m\rangle
&=A\omega^m|m+1\rangle,\\
P_2\mathcal O|m\rangle
&=A\omega^{m+1}|m+1\rangle
=\omega A\omega^m|m+1\rangle,
\end{align*}
so
\begin{align*}
\mathcal O P_2=\omega^{-1}P_2\mathcal O. && \text{basis equality}
\end{align*}
Thus the order-parameter eigenphase is \(\omega^k=e^{2\pi i k/N}\), the same phase that labels the vacuum coordinate and condensate branch.

\textbf{Final Result.}
\[
\boxed{
\vec z_k=\frac{2\pi i k}{N}\vec\rho,\qquad
\langle\operatorname{tr}(\lambda\lambda)\rangle_k=16\pi^2\Lambda^3e^{i(\theta+2\pi k)/N},\qquad
\mathcal O|f_k\rangle=Ae^{2\pi i k/N}|f_k\rangle,\quad
\mathcal O P_2=e^{-2\pi i/N}P_2\mathcal O.
}
\]
\hfill$\blacksquare$

deeper_metadata.revision_intent: Second refinement pass: close remaining alignment gaps by explicitly tying G1 to the center-twisted flux profile, making G4 separate derived branch splitting from controlled phase-diagram inputs, and expanding G5 to include the extended-coordinate saddle inventory, the r_b/L_3=xi/2 scaling, the Lambert-W remnant, and the exact total-derivative cancellation.

rubric_interpretation.schema: Exactly one JSON object with paper_title, contiguous deeper_reasoning_k string fields, and one deeper_metadata object; no extra top-level audit keys.
rubric_interpretation.latex: Each reasoning field is a standalone LaTeX fragment compatible with article, amsmath, and amssymb only; no custom macros or external packages are used.
rubric_interpretation.selection_rule: Keep one high-value entry per canonical goal and fuse core results only when the fusion increases explanatory or verification value.
rubric_interpretation.premise_policy: Numerical or phase-diagram statements not derivable from the extracted algebra are retained as controlled premises and clearly separated from derived equalities.

deeper_reasoning_1.title: Center-twisted monopole profile as center-vortex sector

deeper_reasoning_1.goal_alignment: Directly matches the goal's for-every-N and for-every-monopole-type Wilson-phase and flux-profile success predicate.
deeper_reasoning_1.scientific_payoff: Turns monopole-vortex continuity into four verifiable diagnostics on the same object.
deeper_reasoning_1.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds the two-sided flux-label check and explains why the Wilson phase detects the localized center flux rather than the choice of constant-flux side.
deeper_reasoning_1.formal_sharpness: Distinguishes derived algebraic facts from the solved-profile localization premise.
deeper_reasoning_1.low_value_rejection_audit: Avoids restating the full microscopic action because it is feasibility context, not a deeper derivation.

major_advancement_modes: fuses large-L3 bion vacua, small-L3 twist compatibility, holomorphic condensate extraction, and Fourier operator diagonalization

deeper_reasoning_2.scientific_payoff: Shows that the same k label simultaneously indexes geometry, holomorphy, and low-energy operator algebra.
deeper_reasoning_2.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Integrates the Fourier-shift calculation into the vacuum-continuity story instead of leaving it as an isolated core lemma.
deeper_reasoning_2.formal_sharpness: Uses only root-of-unity, Weyl-periodicity, and holomorphic derivative steps already present in the core extraction.
deeper_reasoning_2.low_value_rejection_audit: Does not create separate duplicate entries for each vacuum derivation; one fused entry has higher explanatory value.
deeper_reasoning_2.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The equality of large- and small-L3 descriptions is demonstrated at the semiclassical observable level, not as a proof of all correlation functions.

major_advancement_modes: separates admissibility of the wrapped wall from dominance of its exponent
deeper_reasoning_3.goal_alignment: Matches the goal's two-saddle Wilson-loop predicate and derives the square-loop crossover condition.
deeper_reasoning_3.scientific_payoff: Prevents the common misreading that the center twist alone implies dominance; dominance requires exponent comparison.
deeper_reasoning_3.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Elevates the result from a formula to a decision rule for arbitrary loop geometry.

deeper_reasoning_3.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The saddle weights are semiclassical estimates; the entry avoids claiming an exact equality for the Wilson loop.

major_advancement_modes: derives the branch energy directly from the monopole-induced mass term and separates branch splitting from phase-diagram inputs

deeper_reasoning_5.title: SU(2) bion saddle inventory versus exact supersymmetric cancellation
major_advancement_modes: connects extended-coordinate saddle tracking, r_b/L3 scaling, numerical saddle annihilation, Lambert-W remnant, and total-derivative cancellation
deeper_reasoning_5.goal_alignment: Matches all G5 success components: large-L3 magnetic minima, approximate annihilation point, unstable remnant, and exact cancellation of the supersymmetric bion amplitude.
deeper_reasoning_5.scientific_payoff: Resolves the apparent tension between disappearance of a stable saddle and zero net vacuum energy by assigning them to different mathematical statements.
deeper_reasoning_5.nontrivial_advance_over_sources: Adds the dimensionless r_b/L3=xi/2 scaling and the explicit cylindrical-Laplacian step in the total-derivative proof.
deeper_reasoning_5.formal_sharpness: Keeps xi_c as numerical saddle-tracking input while deriving the Lambert-W and boundary-cancellation formulas explicitly.
deeper_reasoning_5.low_value_rejection_audit: Does not infer the numerical value xi_c from the asymptotic Lambert-W calculation; this avoids a false analytic derivation.
deeper_reasoning_5.known_residual_risks_and_mitigation: The exact value 0.44 remains numerical; the derivation makes this explicit and derives only the analytic consequences supported by the core reasoning.

rejected_low_value_candidates: A separate entry only restating the Yang-Mills action was rejected because it would add feasibility context rather than deeper reasoning.
A separate entry only restating the Fourier basis was rejected after its operator-algebra payoff was integrated into the vacuum-continuity entry.
